model_annotation: This pie chart represents the distribution of levels within a hierarchical catalogue, illustrating the breakdown of items based on their level designation. The chart contains three distinct slices, each representing a different level: “Level - 8.2” colored blue, occupying approximately 30.04% of the total area; “Level2 - 12.1” colored blue, representing approximately 44.32% of the total area; and “Level3 - 7.0” colored blue, accounting for approximately 25.64% of the total area. Percentage labels are included within each slice indicating the proportion of the whole that each segment represents. The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of area.
